## Overdue reminders

Runs every day at 08:00 UTC. It asks Convex for loans whose return date has passed and that have not already been reminded today.

Claiming a reminder is idempotent. A retry will not send a second message for the same loan and day unless the earlier claim is at least 10 minutes old and was not completed.

Set the error workflow to **LendLoop error handler** before publishing.
